pages.text: Vanilla rules still apply: you mine, craft and build exactly as before. On top of that:

$(li)$(l:world/terrain)Terrain$(/l) is reshaped: higher peaks, deeper valleys and oceans.$(li)$(l:creatures/wildlife_overview)Wildlife$(/l) lives in every biome, and a few $(l:wild_monsters/overview)wild monsters$(/l) prowl particular regions.$(li)$(l:places/overview)Structures$(/l): dungeons, strongholds, temples, mineshafts, fortresses and monuments are rebuilt, and new lairs are scattered about.

$(li)$(l:bosses/overview)Bosses$(/l) live in those lairs, each with a boss bar and a real attack pattern.$(li)$(l:combat/movesets)Weapon movesets$(/l) replace the single vanilla swing.$(li)$(l:armour/accessories)Accessory slots$(/l) hold rings, necklaces, gloves, belts and charms.$(li)$(l:systems/gravestones)Gravestones$(/l) keep your items safe when you die.$(li)$(l:systems/waystones)Waystones$(/l) let you travel between places you have visited, for experience.$(li)$(l:help/shaders)Emberveil Shaders$(/l) give the world its look (press <key:iris.keybind.toggleShaders> to turn them off).
